# Hmimi Chioukh — AI Product Designer

## What I Do
I design scalable SaaS platforms and digital experiences. Product Designer specializing in UI/UX, AI-powered workflows, and design systems.

## Case Studies
- **DadyCar** — Ride-sharing platform for Algeria. 50K+ users, 200% ROI, 4.6★ App Store rating.
- **FocusCare** — Telehealth platform for Saudi Arabia. 95% appointment rate, $20M+ revenue, 300K+ patients.
- **Shihany** — EdTech marketplace connecting tutors and students. 12K+ students, 40% revenue growth.
- **Resaglob** — Logistics SaaS platform for global operations.

## Skills
